model_annotation: The plot illustrates the loss values over the course of training iterations for several language models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1440000, with tick labels spaced by 10000 increments. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is a linear scale ranging from approximately 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels spaced by 0.2 increments. A solid red line represents the Vanilla model, decreasing from approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 to approximately 2.4 at iteration 1440000. A dashed orange line represents the StrmLLL model with n=64 iterations, beginning at approximately 3.2 and decreasing to approximately 2.6 over the course of the iterations. A solid blue line represents the StrmLLL model with n=64 iterations, starting at approximately 3.1 and decreasing to approximately 2.7. A solid green line represents the SepLLM with n=64 iterations, starting at approximately 3.0 and decreasing to approximately 2.9. A solid magenta line represents the SepLLM with n=64, H, starting at approximately 3.0 and decreasing to approximately 2.8. Finally, a solid dark blue line shows the SepLLM with n=128 iterations, decreasing from approximately 3.0 at iteration 0 to approximately 2.7 at iteration 1440000.
